scripts.build: npm run build:inzDateSelect && npm run build:inzVrPreview
scripts.build:inzDateSelect: tsc -p inzDateSelect && sass --no-source-map inzDateSelect/src/inzDateSelect.scss inzDateSelect/dist/inzDateSelect/inzDateSelect.css && cpx "inzDateSelect/src/*.yml" inzDateSelect/dist/inzDateSelect && cpx "inzDateSelect/src/manifest" inzDateSelect/dist/inzDateSelect
scripts.build:inzVrPreview: tsc -p inzVrPreview && cpx "inzVrPreview/src/*.py" inzVrPreview/dist/inzVrPreview && cpx "inzVrPreview/src/*.yml" inzVrPreview/dist/inzVrPreview && cpx "inzVrPreview/src/manifest" inzVrPreview/dist/inzVrPreview
